extra.reason: Consolidated to single index.js: removed uncompress/zip logic (node-zipkit, mkdirp deps dropped), fixed getCorpusPath to work identically local/Lambda via CORPUS_PATH env override + __dirname-relative default, kept lambda-index.js's LRU cache + per-file resilience, deleted lambda-index.js. Fixed as part of ax8 consolidation: cleanName now uses /\.(txt|js)$/gi (escaped dot, case-insensitive) and /^[/\\]/ (properly anchored separator strip). Verified against real corpus's SWSECOND.TXT (previously mismatched due to case-sensitivity).

Fixed both scripts' require paths to point at src/lib/ (source of truth) instead of the nonexistent test/manual-runners/lib/ (writepoem.js) or the dead duplicate apps/poeticalbot/lib/ (pattern-match.runner.js). Added test/manual-runners.tests.js (2 tests, TDD: watched writepoem.js's MODULE_NOT_FOUND fail first) as regression coverage against these paths breaking again once textgen-monorepo-hk9 deletes the dead lib/ tree. Both scripts now resolve modules cleanly; deeper pipeline bugs found while manually verifying (null output with no default method, regex crash, nlp API mismatch) split out to textgen-monorepo-5ts since they're unrelated to the require-path issue this bead covered. Verified: 270 passing / 1 pre-existing unrelated failure in poeticalbot's unit suite.

Replaced the Heroku-era 'running'/'publishing' sections with the current nx-based workflow. Verified both documented commands actually work: 'nx cli:sample poeticalbot' produces a real poem (queneau-buckets, no post), 'nx cli:help poeticalbot' shows the real flag list. Also documents the now-fixed test/manual-runners/writepoem.js (textgen-monorepo-8te) including its no-default-method gotcha (textgen-monorepo-5ts). Corrected a false claim I initially wrote (a .env.example that doesn't actually exist) after checking. Left the generator/transformer/title/corpus/roadmap sections untouched — still accurate.

Removed the console.log(JSON.stringify(config)) at index.js:60 that dumped consumerKey/consumerSecret/accessToken/accessSecret in plaintext on every successful list generation. TDD: added test/index.tests.js, spawns node index.js with fake env-injected credentials (so it doesn't depend on/risk leaking the real local .env) and asserts none appear in stdout — watched it fail against the real bug before fixing. Verified no regressions in listmania's util/textutil suites.

Fixed math.random(arr.length) -> math(arr.length) in pickRemove (src/lib/util.js:73). random-seed's math.random() takes no args and ignores them, returning a float in [0,1) that splice() truncates to index 0 — pickRemove always removed the first element, never random. TDD: added test/util.tests.js 'functional tests' block (the file had a literal 'TODO: okay, now actually test the methods!' — addressed for pickRemove) with a seeded deterministic test (seed 'test-seed', 5-element array) computed against random-seed's real API, watched it fail with the exact always-index-0 pattern before fixing. Verified 272 passing / 1 pre-existing unrelated failure in the unit suite.

Deleted duplicate lib/, lambda/, filter/ trees + dead root index.js/config.js/Procfile (all confirmed unreferenced, matches .kiro consolidation spec task 11). Fixed package.json start script to src/index.js. 242 unit tests pass.

validateNPF now rejects empty content arrays (npf-formatter.js:168). TDD: added failing test in test/npf-formatting.tests.js confirming empty poem -> content:[] passed validation, then fixed check to length===0 -> false. Both real callers (src/index.js, tumblr-client.js) already throw/reject on false, so this closes the live-post-empty-post hole. 243 unit tests pass.

Extracted both buggy retry loops into src/lib/retry-bounds.js (boundedLetterFilter, retryTitle) for testability, TDD'd 5 tests in test/retry-bounds.tests.js, wired both back into poetifier.js. letterExistsFilterTransform now caps at 25 attempts instead of spinning unbounded on a scarce/absent letter. Title retry now actually checks for a blank title (trim().length===0 instead of the always-false split().length===0) and caps at 10 attempts instead of running exactly once regardless. 248 unit tests pass (1 pre-existing flaky unseeded-random test unrelated to this change, confirmed flaky before/after).

Added scripts/generate-lambda-package-json.js: derives Lambda package.json from the app's real package.json (drops workspace:* deps served via Lambda layer, keeps real dep versions + engines), replacing both apps' hand-authored heredocs. Fixes the drift bug directly: poeticalbot's tumblr.js now correctly ^5.0.0 (was hardcoded ^3.0.0) and node engine ^22.16.0 (was 18.x); listmania's node engine now 22.x (was 18.x). Wired into both build-lambda.sh scripts, ran both end-to-end (npm install + zip) successfully, standard lint clean.

2 of 3 sub-bugs fixed: (2) linereduce.js stripPunct regex now strips full leading/trailing punctuation runs instead of one char, fixing the 'Invalid regular expression: Unmatched )' crash from OCR'd unbalanced parens -- reproduced 8/15 direct runs before fix, 0/15 after; exposed stripPunct from LineReduce and TDD'd it directly rather than relying on a lucky corpus draw. (3) test/manual-runners/pattern-match.runner.js never built the compromise nlpObj it passed to getMatchingLines (lrRunner.js, the real production caller, does this correctly -- the script just never copied that step), causing n.match() to throw on undefined; fixed to match lrRunner.js's pattern, and tightened the masking test in manual-runners.tests.js that was passing even while the script crashed.

Item (1), 'no default generation method', does NOT reproduce: the strategy fallback (if (!strategy) strategy = util.pick(strategies)) predates this bead (present since the initial monorepo migration commit) and is unconditional. Ran 28+ direct Poetifier.poem() calls with no config.method set (including forcing config.reduce=true to stress the same code paths) -- zero null-lines results. Not closing this as fixed since nothing was changed for it; leaving as an open question rather than inventing a fix for an unreproduced bug. If it resurfaces, need an exact repro (corpus filter, seed) to pin down.

Replaced StandardJS with Prettier across all 3 packages (poeticalbot, listmania, common-corpus), matching Standard's style (semi:false, singleQuote:true) so the tooling swap itself doesn't also relitigate style. Removed standard everywhere, added prettier as shared root devDependency, removed 2 stale/contradictory .eslintrc files, replaced all 3 project.json lint targets (poeticalbot/listmania: standard -> prettier --check; common-corpus: broken no-op @nx/eslint:lint -> the same prettier --check pattern, now a real working lint target). Scoped to **/*.js only (Standard never touched JSON/Markdown) with --ignore-path to keep common-corpus's ~75MB corpus/ data out of formatting. Updated CLAUDE.md and listmania's MONOREPO_INTEGRATION.md.

Along the way, running each package's FULL test suite (not just test:unit) surfaced two things test:unit's integration-test filter had been silently masking: (1) 4 assertions in poeticalbot's integration tests still checking for the lambda/ directory removed in hk9 -- fixed to check the new consolidated src/ structure instead, plus cleaned up an orphaned untracked lambda/node_modules leftover git rm couldn't reach; (2) a genuinely pre-existing, unrelated bug where src/lambda-handler.js exports a class but its test expects a destructured {handler} function -- filed separately as textgen-monorepo-5kh rather than fixed here.

Per user's answers: matched Standard's style, did all 3 packages in one pass, skipped pre-commit hooks/CI (none exist in this repo currently). Note: pure Prettier only formats -- it doesn't replace StandardJS's lint rules (no-unused-vars, prefer-const, etc). That's a real tradeoff of the 'skip ESLint+prettier combo' choice, worth knowing if lint-rule enforcement (not just formatting) is wanted later.
